failure_modes: A time-ramp or dose edit would displace surrounding non-core coordinates via the positive-weight regional attention term without demonstrated affinity benefit, since no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied.

The nearest-teacher geometric comparison is not the score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, so a dose change justified by teacher distance could be a wrong-direction edit rather than a weak-dose correction.
Any apparent improvement from a ramp exponent would be unverifiable within this study because no current-study outcome data are available to the design roles.
rationale: D1.2: The offered choices are only dose (native_rms_ratio C001-C003) and time-ramp power (C004-C006); no registered choice changes teacher coordinates or regional attention, so the permitted time-conditioned alternative is not selectable here and the stationary coordinate target stands. The observed curves do show sign changes and rate reversals with no accepted polynomial (E2e106e083189d150, E03ad082bb04f4f9c), which supports H001 in principle, but the only lever that could express it is a ramp exponent, and the evidence does not establish that a ramp improves the endpoint pointcloud reward. D3.1: Delivery diagnostics show mean_delivered_over_calibration ~0.33 with backtrack_fraction 0.0, cap_active_fraction 0.0 and zero_injection_fraction 0.0 at every observed node, i.e. the incumbent dose is delivered cleanly with no clipping or backtracking, so there is no evidence of a wrong direction or a weak dose to correct; whole-reward rescaling canceled by normalization would not be an effective dose edit. D3.2: The schedule is fixed at time_ramp_power 0.0 in the incumbent; the observed support is the learning window [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times (E0857891f4effbfe1) and the curve-support fidelity rule retained 24 features (Ed4e7d28e7b0423e0), but no evidence compares continuous dose allocation against the fixed schedule on delivered coverage, so the fixed schedule is retained. D4.1: The information audit states the geometric nearest-teacher comparison is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that teacher score correlations are observational, not a validated affinity predictor (E2bb8390452ed517a); lineage support shows heavy ancestral sparsity and that survival multiple testing is not terminal affinity (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1). With no decoded terminal affinity labels and no current-study outcome, no offered edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, so retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported choice. D4.2: Predicted failure response if a ramp or dose edit were taken: unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates, since the regional term uses a detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention with positive surrounding weight, so a stronger or time-weighted force would move non-core coordinates without a demonstrated affinity benefit; this prediction reinforces retaining the incumbent under the affinity-first priority.
